newsitem.title: MEXICO: Quake hits Mexico, no initial reports of injuries.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits Mexico, no initial reports of injuries.

text.p: An earthquake measured at 5.9 on the Richter scale hit the coasts of Michoacan and Guerrero states at 2:53 a.m. (0753 GMT) on Thursday, official news agency Notimex reported.
The quake woke many from sleep in capital Mexico City but initial reports did not mention any damage or injuries.
Local reports said the quake lasted about one minute and that its epicentre was near the Balsas river, close to Pacific Coast port city Lazaro Cardenas.
The site is approximately 200 miles (300 km) southwest of Mexico City.
Local Red Cross and government authorities said in initial reports that they visited affected areas and found no damage or injuries, but that some people were treated for nerves.
